newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar slides after funds sell NY raws.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar slides after funds sell NY raws.

text.p: London's spot December white sugar contract picked up the bearish tone seen in the New York market when funds baled out of the March raws but volume on the whites stayed relatively low, traders said on Friday.
The London market was slightly firmer during light morning activity but the sudden weakness in New York caused values to take a pounding as commission houses sold the white premium.
"It (the weakness in the raws) was a decision by the funds and we've seen the stops go down to 10.55 (cents/lb)," said one London trader.
"It (London) is just going down with New York...but the volume's not that good," he said.
At 1605 GMT December was 70 cents lower at $317.50 after bouncing off an intraday low of $316.00, just $1.00 above its nearest chart support point.
The second-month March contract was 90 cents lower at $314.50 and volume totalled 974 lots.
Paris positions were also lower in a total volume of 649 lots. December was down $1.00 at $317.50 and March $1.60 lower at $314.50.
